{"metadata":{"description":"Auditable, token-gated DeepSeek Harness remote gateway: mobile QR access, per-device sessions, Host/Origin rewrite, settings/credentials/directory support.","id":"gh:1334709708","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-full-remote","slug":"JUANWANG-BUAA/dsh-full-remote","topics":["ai","authentication","cloudflared","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","home-server","llm","mobile","mobile-ui","ngrok","nodejs","proxy","remote-access","reverse-proxy","security","self-hosted","tunnel","typescript","websocket"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Auditable, token-gated DeepSeek Harness remote gateway: mobile QR access, per-device sessions, Host/"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Origin rewrite, settings/credentials/directory support."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-full-remote"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Listed in awesome-dsh-plugin** · DeepSeek Harness plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Current release: v0.5.0** · Distributed through GitHub Releases"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-full-remote` is a plugin for
DeepSeek Harness. It
places an authenticated reverse proxy in fron"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t of the Harness Web server,
so the Web UI can be used through a public tunnel or from a device on t"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"he
local network while privileged APIs such as settings, credentials, and
directory browsing remain "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"etwork while privileged APIs such as settings, credentials, and
directory browsing remain available."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## New in 0.5.0"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- A selectable cross-session **Task cockpit** for approvals, questions, plan review
and session navi"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"gation; page-lifetime drafts, offline guards and no write replay.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. The remote browser connects to the public tunnel, which forwards to the
plugin's listener (`127.0"},{"id":"p11s2","text":".0.1:3081` by default).
2. A request is accepted only with an access token, a valid one-time
invite,"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" or an existing device session. Requests that fail
authentication do not reach the backend.
3. The p"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"roxy rewrites `Host`/`Origin` to loopback, removes untrusted
headers, and forwards the request to th"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"e Harness Web server at
`127.0.0.1:3080`. Compressible HTTP responses (HTML/JS/CSS/JSON/SVG,
≥1 KB) "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"may use Brotli/gzip; SSE and WebSocket are not compressed. Eligible
hashed `/assets/*` files receive"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" private immutable caching and bounded
device-isolated server variants. HTML/API are not stored in t"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"hat static cache.
See HTTP transport and the
benchmark."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`
- A DeepSeek Harness **web** profile running **0.2** (`0.2.1-rc.2`, the"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" npm
`next` dist-tag and the version shipped by DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1).
The plugin depends "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"on the `webServer` and Host `connection` services plus the
0.2 client services (`uiSession`, `uiWork"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"space`, `ui-approval`,
`ui-user-questions`) and is not intended for headless profiles. 0.1.x is no
l"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"onger supported: the 0.2 client removed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`
and moved pending interact"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ions into the `uiSession` registry. 0.2.1 adds the
Remote access snapshot (`dsh-api-remote-access`);"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" it does not restrict the
browsers this proxy serves — see
compatibility."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The Host/Origin rewrite restores the privileged APIs and, at the same
time, disables Harness's origi"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nal protection for remote clients. The
access-control layer provided by this plugin consists of:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- a 192-bit access token, stored locally with file mode `0600`;
- an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` s"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ession cookie per device, carrying a
per-device secret of which only a hash is stored;
- a fixed del"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ay plus a per-IP `429` lockout on failed logins;
- loopback-only control routes (`/dsh-reverse-proxy"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"/*`), which require a
control header and are never forwarded through the public proxy;
- removal of "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"spoofable forwarding and hop-by-hop headers, so the proxy's
own cookie never reaches the backend;
- "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"optional `trustForwardedFor`: when enabled, only a loopback peer's
rightmost `X-Forwarded-For` value"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" is trusted for CIDR / rate-limit / audit.
`CF-Connecting-IP` needs the separate, Cloudflare-only
`t"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"rustCloudflareConnectingIp` opt-in; loopback or malformed values are
never trusted. Keep both disabl"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ed for direct LAN access."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The access token must be treated as a secret. Terminate TLS on the public
side of the tunnel. For LA"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"N use without a tunnel, set
`tlsCertFile` / `tlsKeyFile` (for example with
mkcert)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Public exposure checklist.** Whoever holds the token controls the whole
Harness — credentials and "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"settings included — so for anything reachable
from the internet:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- enable `approvalMode: true`, so a new device stays pending until you
approve it in the local panel"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" (the panel shows a warning whenever the
quick tunnel is online with approval off);
- consider `allo"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"wedCidrs` to pin the entry to known networks;
- keep `auditLog: true` (the default) and rotate the t"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"oken after invites
outlive their need."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Control actions (start, stop, reveal token, change listen address) can
only be performed from the "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"local Harness window, not from the tunnel
URL.
- Settings persistence on a remote page relies on a t"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"emporary trust pin
until Harness provides a proper deployment trust field. On Harness
`0.1.0-rc.8` a"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"nd later, that pin must survive the official ModuleLoader
`create()` replacing `load`; otherwise Set"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"tings → Models shows
`settings are unavailable in this browser`. "Open on host" from a phone
acts on"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" the machine running Harness.
- `allowTokenRead` defaults to `false`. When explicitly enabled, `GET "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"/token`
is served over loopback HTTP, so any local process that sends the control
header can read th"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"e token; rotation always returns the replacement token.
- By default, a tunnel running on the same m"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"achine makes every remote
client appear as `127.0.0.1` to the proxy. `allowedCidrs` and per-IP
login"},{"id":"p22s10","text":" lockout therefore apply to the tunnel as a whole unless
`trustForwardedFor: true` is set behind a t"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"rusted local edge.
- The plugin replaces Harness's remote trust check with its own
access-control la"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"yer. A defect in this layer has serious consequences.
If Harness provides official remote access in "},{"id":"p22s13","text":"the future, the role of
this plugin should be reassessed.
- The one-click quick tunnel: the URL is r"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"andom per start (old invites
and logins stop working), Cloudflare positions quick tunnels as
tempora"},{"id":"p22s15","text":"ry/testing with terms limiting heavy non-HTML content, and the
first use downloads cloudflared on de"},{"id":"p22s16","text":"mand (18–52 MB depending on the
platform; Windows ARM64 has no official build — install it yourself
"},{"id":"p22s17","text":"and set `cloudflaredPath`). For a stable daily entry, bring your own
frp / ngrok / named tunnel.
- P"},{"id":"p22s18","text":"roxy-side Brotli/gzip can help LAN and SSH/frp; a Cloudflare quick tunnel
may already compress at th"},{"id":"p22s19","text":"e edge, so do not assume the same byte savings
there. Static proxy-cache hits can still avoid upstre"},{"id":"p22s20","text":"am work. Live model
WebSocket output, SSE and plugin login/wait/home pages are not compressed
by thi"},{"id":"p22s21","text":"s HTTP path. Full contract: HTTP transport;
measured gains and costs: benchmark."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Contributing · Security · License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- CONTRIBUTING.md
- SECURITY.md
